name: codebase-mentor
description: Set up repo design context once, use focused subsystem guides during changes, and keep documentation grounded in source.

interface.longDescription: Set up a repository once so agents can use its design context during ordinary work. Onboard drafts or reuses a short map and focused subsystem guides, asks up to three targeted questions, and configures selected clients. Mentor checks current source, applies relevant design constraints, and proposes focused documentation corrections for review. Configuration and observed client use are reported separately.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codebase Mentor for this repo. Draft from source and ask about important design decisions.
Use codebase-mentor to find the design constraints, relevant examples, and tests for my next change.
Is Codebase Mentor set up correctly here? Report configuration and anything still unverified.

publication.release_notes: Adds repo setup and status, focused subsystem guides, ordinary-task context preparation, and reviewed drift corrections.
